**Draft — awaiting visual review. Not approved until the screenshots are accepted.** Follow-up to #62 (base `arena/3e360305-btc-trading-assistant` @ `a0f1faf`). Frontend presentation only: no detector, threshold, market-data, risk, trade-plan, paper-trading, schema, API, event or config change. #62 is not modified.

Corrects the **Chart Patterns** function to match the approved `BRAIN_Approved_Chart_Patterns.png` (1672 × 941).

### Before → after at 1672 × 941 (after = Double Bottom selected in Card 2)
![comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/70402fe7ebc0abd9963cf7b1b1312f4ced320085/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/comparison-before-after-1672x941.png)

Full A–P report, stored record ids, timestamps, prices, measurements, deviations and remaining defects: [`docs/visual-signoff/patterns/REPORT.md`](https://github.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/blob/70402fe7ebc0abd9963cf7b1b1312f4ced320085/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/REPORT.md)

### A–P summary
All 16 checks pass:
- A header
- B proportions: 71.2 % / 15 px / 26.6 %
- C three cards
- D candles
- E trough anchors: within 0.2 px of the stored candles
- F neckline at the stored 84229.90
- G "Double Bottom - Confirmed" only because the record is confirmed
- H lifecycle badge
- I confidence "Not calculated"
- J other-patterns selection
- K key levels: Resistance Unavailable
- L volume
- M no clipped labels
- N zoom kept (pans, never zooms; see note)
- O mobile
- P no unexpected console errors

Breakouts & Retests is unchanged: the screenshot at 1672 is byte-identical before and after.

### Deviations caused by missing data or absent controls
- **Confidence:** the reference shows 87 %; no confidence is stored, so it reads "Not calculated".
- **Bull Flag and Descending Triangle:** not stored, so not shown.
- **Target:** not stored, so it reads Unavailable.
- **Toolbar buttons:** Indicators, Layout and Trade are not real controls, so they are not added.
- **Default selection:** first open selects the newest record (an invalidated Double Top). The reference view is one click away.
- **Window rule:** the window pans when the selected pattern is not wholly visible, keeping the same candle count. Switching to the looser Breakouts rule is a one-line change in `ensurePatternInView` if preferred.
- **Pixel overlay:** not possible because the reference PNG is not in the repo.

### Test results (exact)
```
$ npm test
# tests 440
# suites 0
# pass 440
# fail 0
# cancelled 0
# skipped 0
# todo 0
```
```
$ python -m pytest -q

XFAIL tests/test_decision_invariance.py::test_a_shallow_stored_start_does_not_change_live_setups_at_a_later_boundary  (preserved)
```
```
$ ruff check --isolated --select E4,E7,E9,F src tests
Found 15 errors.   # all pre-existing, identical on a0f1faf; no Python changed
```
Real browser (Chromium, synthetic demo DB, viewports 1672×941, 1440×900, 1920×1080 and 390):
- `node scripts/browser-audit/patterns-check.mjs` → exit 0
- `node scripts/browser-audit/breakouts-check.mjs` → exit 0

### Files changed
- `js/pattern_view.js` (new)
- `js/chart.js`
- `js/function_panel.js`
- `js/views/dashboard.js`
- `styles.css`: Patterns rules scoped to the Patterns screen

## Follow-up commit `600e015`: exact design + multi-pattern presentation (frontend only, awaiting review)

_Added on top of `70402fe` at the owner's request (this session can only push to this branch). Everything above describes `70402fe` and is unchanged._

**Full report:** [`docs/visual-signoff/patterns/multi-pattern/REPORT.md`](https://github.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/blob/600e01583be7c25b805342bbc55e2463901a9c9a/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/multi-pattern/REPORT.md). It covers the support matrix, default rule, measurements, audits, limitations and the engine proposal.

### Support matrix
| Pattern | Status |
|---|---|
| Double Bottom, Double Top, Head and Shoulders, Inverse Head and Shoulders | **DETECTED + TESTED**: `pattern_liquidity/classical_patterns.py`, `tests/test_pattern_liquidity.py`. Verified on screen. |
| Rectangle / Trading Range | **PARTIAL**: `market_structure/ranges.py`, active range only. No lifecycle or breakout linkage, so the target is "Unavailable". |
| Ascending, Descending and Symmetrical Triangle; Bull and Bear Flag; Rising and Falling Wedge; Pennant; Rising and Falling Channel; Cup and Handle | **NOT IMPLEMENTED**: no detector, never shown |

### What changed
- **Double Bottom drawing (reference):**
  - two small green arcs (≤ 8 bars per side, never past the stored low);
  - Bottom 1 and Bottom 2 on their stored candles;
  - a thin dashed neckline at the stored price, ending on the confirmation candle;
  - a "Double Bottom - Confirmed" box with a 52px connector;
  - no large shading (largest fill = 1.4% of the pane).
- **Per-type geometry:**
  - Double Top and H&S get caps;
  - inverse H&S gets troughs;
  - the range is a faint box with Range high/low;
  - invalidated records are grey with no confirmation line;
  - an outline fallback covers future validated types, built from their own points only.
- **Selection:**
  - every genuinely detected record is listed in Card 2 and selectable; selecting updates the overlay and all three cards;
  - the default is deterministic: current not-invalidated records, then newest `known_at`, then id; the range comes last;
  - no "strongest" claim, and confidence stays "Not calculated";
  - a manual choice and the zoom survive switches;
  - no stale timeframe drawings.
- **Layout:** the card column now ends with the chart, and Card 2 scrolls inside its own card when there are more rows.
- **Untouched:** detectors, thresholds, strategy, signals, risk, execution, schema, APIs and event contracts.

### Results (exact)
- `npm test`: **446 tests, 446 pass, 0 fail** (was 440)
- `pytest -q`: **1185 passed, 1 xfailed, 1 warning in 233.26s** (xfail preserved)
- `ruff check --isolated --select E4,E7,E9,F src tests`: **Found 15 errors** (the same pre-existing 15)
- `patterns-check.mjs` on the standard demo and the multi-pattern demo (1672×941, 1440×900, 1920×1080, 390): both **exit 0**, no unexpected console errors. Every listed record was selected, and the drawn default matches the documented rule recomputed from the API.
- `breakouts-check.mjs` on this build vs `70402fe` with the same DB: **20/20 screenshots byte-identical**, so Breakouts & Retests is unchanged.

### Screenshots
| | |
|---|---|
| Double Bottom (default, 1672) | ![](https://github.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/blob/600e01583be7c25b805342bbc55e2463901a9c9a/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/multi-pattern/01-1672-double-bottom-default.png?raw=true) |
| Head and Shoulders (default, multi-pattern demo) | ![](https://github.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/blob/600e01583be7c25b805342bbc55e2463901a9c9a/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/multi-pattern/02-1672-head-and-shoulders-default.png?raw=true) |
| Inverse H&S selected | ![](https://github.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/blob/600e01583be7c25b805342bbc55e2463901a9c9a/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/multi-pattern/03-1672-select-inverse-head-and-shoulders.png?raw=true) |
| Double Top (invalidated) | ![](https://github.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/blob/600e01583be7c25b805342bbc55e2463901a9c9a/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/multi-pattern/05-1672-select-double-top-invalidated.png?raw=true) |
| Trading Range selected | ![](https://github.com/bailey-j-b-123/btc-trading-assistant/blob/600e01583be7c25b805342bbc55e2463901a9c9a/docs/visual-signoff/patterns/multi-pattern/06-1672-select-trading-range.png?raw=true) |

Also in the folder: 1440, 1920, 390 mobile, Detailed, 4H empty states, Breakouts.

### Limitations
- There is no pixel side-by-side, because IMG_3400 is not in the repo; the comparison uses the earlier measurements (owner chose this).
- At 1440×900, Card 2 shows about 1½ rows and scrolls.
- In both demos, secondary outlines fall outside the default zoom, so they are unit-tested only.
- Pre-existing: "FORMING 1H" on 4H, a gridline across the empty-chart message, and the mobile header rows.

### Needs approval (separate engine task, not started)
New types need a detector, thresholds, lifecycle, an additive sloped-line evidence field and tests.

`setup_qualification/rules.py` currently records every confirmed `chart_patterns` type except double bottom and inverse H&S as **bearish**. A new bullish type would therefore be recorded with the wrong direction, so this change touches strategy records. The exact proposal is in §8 of the report.

**Stopping here for review.**

## Follow-up 2 (`ee6ab77`): PICTURE 1 at 1536×864

Fast-forward commit on this branch (`600e015` → `ee6ab77`). The brief expected `70402fe` as the head of this PR; its actual head was `600e015` (turn 3), which this commit builds on. It touches only the frontend, the demo seed and tests. Detectors, strategy, thresholds, signals, risk, schema, APIs and event contracts are unchanged.

Report: `docs/visual-signoff/patterns/reference-1536/REPORT.md`, with screenshots `01`–`13` and full audit JSON.

**Fixed at 1536×864 (compared against PICTURE 1):**
- **Toolbar:** a single row again; before, it overflowed by 117px. Same controls.
- **Card 1:** the title is on one line.
- **Chart head:** the OHLC line no longer collides with the forming-candle note.
- **Price axis:** sans-serif 13px with no trailing decimals ("84,800"), on Chart Patterns only, and restored exactly when leaving.
- **Volume:** the bars sit below the "Volume" label.
- **Secondary drawings:** records nearest in time come first, so the grey outlines are of genuine patterns on screen.
- **Cards:** proportions now 350 / 165 / 194px, and Card 2 shows two rows.
- **Title:** it never covers a candle; this is audited for every selection at every size.
- **Multi-pattern DEMO seed:** the default is now a confirmed Double Bottom, with a genuine invalidated Double Top secondary.

**Results:**
- `npm test`: **449/449 pass**.
- `pytest -q`: **1185 passed, 1 xfailed, 1 warning in 230.18s**.
- `ruff check --isolated --select E4,E7,E9,F src tests`: **15 errors**, all pre-existing.
- `patterns-check.mjs`: exit 0 at 1536×864, 1672×941, 1440×900, 1920×1080 and 390×844, on both DEMO databases. 0 page errors and 0 unexpected console errors.
- `breakouts-check.mjs` vs `600e015` on the same DB: **20/20 screenshots byte-identical**.

**Not done / remaining:**
- There is no pixel side-by-side, because IMG_3400 never reached the workspace; the comparison was made by inspection plus measurement.
- No detector was added. Triangles, flags, wedges, pennants, channels and cup and handle remain NOT IMPLEMENTED (turn-3 report §8 proposal, awaiting approval).
- Remaining visual differences are listed in REPORT §7.

**Stopping here for review.**
